source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The migration changes both no-backing-view window watchers to an equality check for messengercompose.xhtml, while their trigger calls MailUtils.displayMessage and the message-window producer opens messageWindow.xhtml. The two affected tasks are explicitly skipped at the landing and fixed accepted revision. This is a latent predicate/producer mismatch in skipped tests, not evidence of an active test failure or a reproduced hang.
title: Skipped message-window tests filter the compose document instead of the display window
